SqliteTransactionRunner callback 接收 transaction-scoped SqliteExecutor
DefaultSqliteTransactionRunner 成功执行 BEGIN IMMEDIATE → work(executor) → COMMIT
失败执行 BEGIN IMMEDIATE → work throws → ROLLBACK

factory 必须在事务 callback 内用 executor 重建 Repository/Use Case

composition factory 使用 callback executor 构造 Repository
composition factory 再构造 Base Use Case 与 Transactional wrapper
manifest fully_composed=true
正式 implementation entrypoint 指向 composition factory
存在未绑定 External Port 时不猜 adapter

manifest.manual_composition 记录未解析依赖

validate_generated_entrypoints.mjs 对照 IIR transaction_plan_ids 与 manifest
事务 Use Case 不得指向 Base Use Case
fully composed 入口必须来自 composition/generated.ts
